mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 600K units, indicating strengthening demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 600K, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, stimulating equity markets and yielding positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, always.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 7% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts increased consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 3% YoY, indicating a strong supply side, predicts increased productivity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window during tightening cycles, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) in those regimes.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3.5% QoQ, signaling robust demand, directly translates to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% and a rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 2% YoY creates an environment where inflation expectations boost equity markets, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% predicts a strong labor market, which in turn drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as consumer spending remains robust.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1) when UNRATE < 6%.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) growth above 5% YoY, coupled with housing starts (HOUST) above 500K units, signals a broad-based demand increase, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only in post-shock recovery regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances during post-shock recovery, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 2-year rolling window in those regimes.
